{{Quote|Moisture farm-fresh blue buttermilk biscuit and gravy 3.7 credits|The menu description of the biscuits at Dex's|<ref name="DaD" />}}
'''Blue buttermilk biscuits''' were a type of biscuit made using butter-[[Milk/Legends|milk]] made from [[Blue milk/Legends|blue milk]]. The biscuits were available with [[Gravy/Legends|gravy]] for 3.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] as a breakfast side dish at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], an [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]], the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] owner and [[Chef/Legends|chef]] at Dex's, described the biscuits served in his diner as "[[Moisture farm/Legends|moisture farm]] fresh" on the establishment's menu.<ref name="DaD" /> The biscuits were available at some point prior to the destruction of Dex's Diner during the first two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] reign.<ref name="DexEra">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Underworld]]'' established that [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] was destroyed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' later stated that the novel took place around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]]. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' states that the Empire was formed in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], so Dex's Diner was destroyed either during 19 BBY or 18 BBY.</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Blue buttermilk biscuits were first mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] and published exclusively in the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] in [[2009]].
